question: Related Questions Q. I want to know given below things are halal 1.if we go to buy jewelry shops are textile show rooms for buying clothes are jewelries they giving welcome drinks like water or pepsi ,coffee etc (may be they are doing interest business) drinking are eating there is halal for us . 2. we have contacts with jains & marvadis ( may be they are doing interest business) if they are giving gift of chocolates & sweets are halal for us 3. muslim brother is doing some business got the money from bank (interest ),eating or drinking in his house is halal for us . 1840 views Q. I have a question I was hoping you could help me find the answer to inshallah. A friend of mine is studying to be a vet and on completion of their studies they will inshallah work at a vetinary hospital for animals. One of the concerns they have is that on occasions they will have to put down animals for various reasons. The reasons can vary such as the owner of the animal is unable to afford the cost of the operation, the animal is in great pain and so on. In islam is it permissable to put animals down taking into the above reasons and any others you can think of. 1955 views Q. بینك میں كلكركی كی ملازمت 1453 views Q. I want to start business as a distibutor for wholesaling of dish TV antenna system with my nonmuslim business partner. In this business we can install dish tv antenna system at user end .In this business we can sale prepaid vouchers to customer end & also we can sale it to dealers . so please advise whether i should do this business or not? 2265 views Q. working abroad 2309 views Q. We are manufacturer in textile products, we just purchased yarn from a mill on terms of L/C (120 days Payment ) First, I (buyer) request to the mill(Seller) to send us quotation based on payment 120days L/C He (Seller) faxed me (Buyer) the price based on 120 days payment on L/c basis for example US$ 50/bag of yarn. (All markup charges by bank on account of seller ) So in this contact I will not pay any bank interest (or markup) except I will delay the payment after 120days . I am in confidence that in sha' Allah, I will pay to the bank (sellers bank) payment on due date ( within 120days ) My question is this is this contract fulfill the requirements in Islam. Is this type of contract is permissible for me (Buyer) Thanks for yours reply in advance. 1472 views Q. question regarding TV 1767 views Q. Assalaamualeyikum, I am working as an IT Manager in Multinational Company which creates their own scientific products. I have got an opportunity to work with Multinational Financial Bank (Deutshe Bank). I understand this bank deals in Interest. My job profile in this company will be to maintain their worldwide offices network connectivity. Is it allowed to work in Informaton Technology department in Financial banks... Jazaakumullah... 2148 views Q. Vitamin D in Low Fat Milk 1964 views Q. Adobe photoshop software 3005 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. Ration card and sickness 2414 views Q. I am a student. To pay my fees and meet my expenses i have to work part-time.Am i allowed(is it permissible) to work for a store which has lottery in it?I will have to operate the lottery machine also along with the cash register.2).Is it permissible to work for a jewellery store which sells christian symbols like cross and replicas of jesus christ.please reply. 2399 views Q. Using moisturizer and perfum containing alcohol denat is permissable or not? 6066 views Q. I have a 9 months old daughter. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 56926 Country: India Title: میں ایک رئیل اسٹیٹ پرائیویٹ کمپنی میں ملازمت کرتاہوں، اس میں بہت زیادہ بلیک منی ہے، (ٹیکس چوری، رشوت کے پیسے )،لیکن میں کمپنی سے تنخواہ کے علاوہ کوئی منافع نہیں لیتاہوں، براہ کرم، بتائیں کہ کیا یہ حرام ہے یا حلال؟ Question: (۱)میں ایک رئیل اسٹیٹ پرائیویٹ کمپنی میں ملازمت کرتاہوں، اس میں بہت زیادہ بلیک منی ہے، (ٹیکس چوری، رشوت کے پیسے )،لیکن میں کمپنی سے تنخواہ کے علاوہ کوئی منافع نہیں لیتاہوں، براہ کرم، بتائیں کہ کیا یہ حرام ہے یا حلال؟ (۲) میں نے آپ کے فتوی میں پڑھا ہے کہ اسلام میں مشت زنی حرام ہے، تو بتائیں کہ حرام ہونے کی کیا وجہ ہے؟ جس کی شادی نہیں ہوئی ہے، اور گھریلو اور مالی مسائل کی وجہ سے جلدی شادی نہیں کرسکتا، تو وہ اپنی خواہش کو کیسے کرے گا؟(سوائے روزہ رکھنے )۔ براہ کرم، یہ سوال پرائیویٹ میں رکھیں۔شکریہ Answer ID: 56926 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 198-195/B=3/1436-U (۱) اگر آپ سے متعلق کوئی خلاف شرع کام نہ ہو تو کمپنی کی طرف سے ملنے والی تنخواہ آپ کے لیے حلال ہوگی۔ (۲) مشت زنی حرام اورناجائز ہے۔ باقی اگر کوئی شخص غیرشادی شدہ ہو یا شادی شدہ ہو لیکن بیوی تک وصولی پر قادر نہ ہو اور زنا میں یا لواطت میں مبتلا ہونے کا خوف ہو، تو اگر یہ شخص زنا ولواطت سے بچنے کے لیے مشت زنی کے ذریعہ اپنی شہوت کو ٹھنڈی کرلے تو امید ہے کہ اس پر کوئی مواخذہ نہیں ہوگا، حرام ہونے کی علت یہ بھی ہوسکتی ہے کہ اس میں انسان کا خود اپنے جز سے استمتاع کرنا پایا جارہا ہے، اور یہ بھی ہوسکتی ہے کہ اس میں بلاعذر منی کو غیر محل میں گرانا اور شہوت کو بلاعذر غیر محل میں بھڑکانا ہے، جیسا کہ علامہ شامی نے اس کی صراحت کی ہے (رد المحتارم علی الدر المختار: ۳/۳۳۲ ط: دارالکتاب دیوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
